The gen-1 snapshot was installed per-run via run-train-round.mjs --recipe, which copies it into each run's scratch HOME at ~/.rlmx/agents/explore-r/ with `model:` rewritten to the arm's model. agent.yaml budget untouched: max_iterations 14, max_cost 2.00, max_depth 2.

primaryRound.relocationCaveat: round.json's `genDir` and `perTask[].runJson`/`.log` paths are the pre-move gens/gen-1302 paths. summary.json/summary.txt were regenerated in place after the move (node round2/summarize-train-round.mjs <dir>), so their paths are current. Nothing else was edited.
primaryRound.costCaveat: costUsd sums the per-run footers; task 5 returned an error with no footer, so its real spend (a parent plus four pro children) is NOT in that number.

task5Loss.what: task 5 returned `rlmx rlmx_explore-r failed: REPL execution timed out after 600000ms` at 621.2s — the whole run lost, answer 67 chars, 0/5 facts, 0 citations.
task5Loss.class: environment wall, not a model or prompt failure — recursion-recon.md §4.1: rlm_query_batched blocks the parent's Python REPL for the whole fan-out wave, and the per-block REPL clock is separate from the run clock. 4 spawns were observed before the wall.
task5Loss.load: the round ran concurrently with three sibling matrix arms on the same khal key (khal_deepseek-v4-flash, khal_glm-5.2, khal_qwen3.7-max present under optimizer/matrix/), i.e. well beyond the 4-concurrent-children figure §6.1 measured.

task5Rerun.command: RLMX_REPL_TIMEOUT_MS=1500000 RLMX_MCP_RUN_TIMEOUT_MS=1800000 PARITY_CALL_TIMEOUT_MS=1500000 node .genie/wishes/rlmx-explore-offload/parity/round2/run-train-round.mjs --gen 13025 --model khal/deepseek-v4-pro --recipe <gen-1 recipe> --label matrix-khal-deepseek-v4-pro-t5-wall --tasks 5 --concurrency 1 --task-timeout-s 2300
task5Rerun.result: facts=5/5, c2 PASS, c3 PASS, cites=16/16, 4 spawns, 362.9s, $0.22 — it finished in 363s, well inside even the original 600s wall, so the primary loss is attributable to gateway load, not to the model needing more than 600s.
task5Rerun.producedAt: optimizer/gens/gen-13025 (relocated here, same caveat as above)
task5Rerun.howToRead: NOT protocol-identical to the primary round or to the flash baselines: different REPL/run walls and concurrency 1. It is a diagnosis of the task-5 loss, not a substitute measurement. Substituting it would read 30/34 (0.8824); the comparable arm number is 25/34.
